title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. This is part of Grothendieck's description of the 'structure at infinity' of M_{g,ν}. The compactification is assumed to have a normal-crossings boundary D, stratified by strata D_{d_*} indexed by chains d_* = {d_0 > d_1 > ... > d_r}. For nested chains d''_* ⊂ d'_* ⊂ d_*, the previous page sets up vector bundles Ň (normal bundles of one stratum closure in another, or their duals). It derives the exact sequence (287)/(288):

0 → Ň_{d_*,d'_0} → Ň_{d_*,d''_0} → Ň_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} → 0.

This is the familiar sequence of normal bundles for the triple D_{d_*} ⊂ D_{d'_*} ⊂ D_{d''_*}.

This page.
(1) Because D has normal crossings, each such normal bundle locally splits as a direct sum of line bundles, one for each local branch of D containing the stratum. Take the product of the associated G_m-principal bundles, i.e. remove the coordinate hyperplanes. This gives an open subset N^* ⊂ N, with induced opens N^*_{d_*}, N^*_{d_*,d_i} and N^*_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} (289). N^* is a torsor under a torus bundle, or more precisely a bundle of tori twisted by the monodromy that permutes branches. Grothendieck explicitly declines to spell this out.
(2) Definition (290): Ň^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0} is the inverse image of the open Ň^*_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} under the surjection Ň_{d_*,d''_0} → Ň_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} of (287).
(3) Statement (291): Ň^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0} fibres over Ň^*_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)}. It is a torsor, i.e. an affine bundle, under the pull-back of the kernel vector bundle Ň_{d_*,d'_0} along Ň^* → D_{d_*}. Its fibres are therefore contractible.

Purpose (next page). He asserts a heuristic homeomorphism between Ň^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0}|D^*_{d_*} and a piece V^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0} of a deleted tubular neighbourhood near the open stratum D^*_{d_*}. Combined with the homotopy equivalence 'affine bundle → base', this yields a non-canonical, heuristic homotopy equivalence V ≃ Ň^*|D^*. The point is to model the homotopy type of the pieces of the 'tube at infinity' of M_{g,ν} by torus bundles over open boundary strata. This is the standard local model behind tangential base points and the boundary structure of Teichmüller/moduli spaces.
errors: Statement (291) says the torsor is under the inverse image of Ň_{d_*,d_0}. By (287) the kernel is Ň_{d_*,d'_0}, so either the manuscript has a slip or the subscript is mis-read; d'_0 is what the construction requires.

The torus-torsor structure on N^* is only locally a product: global branch monodromy can permute factors, so N^* is a torsor under a possibly twisted torus bundle, not a split one. Grothendieck leaves this unexplicit ('que je me dispense d'expliciter').
The comparison with the tubular piece V (next page) is explicitly heuristic and non-canonical. No proof is offered here.

ideas.what: Complement of the coordinate hyperplanes in the normal bundle of a normal-crossings stratum, as a torus torsor (product of the G_m-bundles of the branch normal line bundles)
ideas.modern_name: punctured normal bundle / torus bundle; complex analogue of the real oriented blow-up boundary (Kato–Nakayama space)
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard (Deligne's tangential base points; Kato–Nakayama 1999 for the log version)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to 'structure à l'infini' and tangential base points, not to this construction

ideas.what: Inverse image of the punctured quotient bundle in an extension of vector bundles, as an affine bundle over a torus bundle
ideas.modern_name: affine bundle / vector-bundle torsor; homotopy equivalent to its base

ideas.what: Using such bundles over open boundary strata as homotopy models of the pieces of a deleted tubular neighbourhood at infinity of M_{g,ν}
ideas.modern_name: homotopy type of the link/tube at infinity of a normal-crossings compactification; boundary of the Harvey/Borel–Serre-type bordification
ideas.usually_credited_to: Harvey (1979), Looijenga, Ivanov; tangential base points: Deligne, Ihara–Nakamura
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the boundary structure of the Teichmüller tower only heuristically

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine local construction: the punctured normal bundle of a normal-crossings stratum, plus an affine bundle over it, used heuristically to model the tube at infinity. It is well known today through log geometry, the Kato–Nakayama space and bordifications of moduli space. Nothing here is new or unfinished in a significant way.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'en loc une décomposition' – likely 'on a loc[alement] une décomposition'.

'qui est d'ailleurs un torseur [?] ..., un [-fibré-] torseur sous ...' – reads roughly 'qui est d'ailleurs un torseur sous un [fibré en] tores, tordu convenablement' ('torsor under a suitably twisted torus bundle').
In (291), the overset 'Ň^*' is a marginal abbreviation naming Ň^*_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} as Ň^*; it is not part of the formula.
End of (291): the projection is Ň^* → D_{d_*}, with the superscript on D uncertain. The vector bundle is written 'Ň_{d_*,d_0}' but should presumably be Ň_{d_*,d'_0}.
